title: DISENTANGLING INFLUENCE: USING DISENTANGLED REPRESENTATIONS TO AUDIT MODEL PREDICTIONS
reasoning: The paper proposes a technical methodology for auditing machine learning models by quantifying the indirect influence of features using disentangled representations. While the method is demonstrated in the context of fairness (auditing for the influence of protected attributes like gender or race), it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, faith traditions, or systems of moral or ethical philosophy.
